notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {G} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vineweft, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Vineweft by paying {4}{G}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
